name: VnCoreNLP three-architecture ablation: nine runs, twenty complete epochs
learning_rate_schedule: linear warmup over 10% of the full twenty-epoch horizon, then linear decay to zero
best_development_checkpoint: recorded separately; highest development exact-span/class micro-F1, earliest tie; not used to select the primary Gold model
checkpoint_policy: retain full model, optimizer, scheduler, RNG states after every completed epoch; retain all twenty epoch checkpoints per run
segmenter: VnCoreNLP-1.2 RDRSegmenter, annotators=[wseg], no Underthesea fallback
prediction_units: original source Unicode token units; shared weighted subword pooling for all heads
labels: 21 BIO tags for the ten frozen entity classes plus O
crf: learned unconstrained linear-chain CRF, token-mean negative log likelihood, Viterbi; shared orphan-I-to-B span decoding
gold_policy: manual evaluation only after all nine epoch-20 models are locked; no Gold scoring inside training
limitations: Most training/development annotations are AI-generated and retain known semantic issues.
Gold Test has been evaluated in a previous experiment; this is a follow-up comparison, not an untouched test.
Twenty epochs are a fixed reporting budget, not a claim of optimal generalization.
